# Lore & Loot Club

> A fan-run review club for LitRPG, fantasy, sci-fi, anime, manga and webtoons. Reviews and discussion happen on Instagram at @loreandlootclub. Powered by FNS (https://fnsing.io/).

## Voting

Visitors vote on the home page for the title the club covers next. One vote per visitor, changeable at any time, no account needed.

## Group reads

Each month the club picks one title. Check-in posts name the chapters they cover so readers are not spoiled. The club motto is "Farm your local library."

## Links

- [Home](https://loreandlootclub.com/): the poll for what the club covers next, what it is reading now and common questions
- [Shelf](https://loreandlootclub.com/shelf): complete LitRPG, fantasy, sci-fi, full-cast audio drama and comic series worth checking out, 55 series and about 277 books
- [Bundles](https://loreandlootclub.com/bundles): the best value LitRPG, fantasy and sci-fi box sets on Audible, ranked by length
- [Authors](https://loreandlootclub.com/authors): authors of the series the club reads, with links
- [Narrators](https://loreandlootclub.com/narrators): audiobook narrators of those series
- [Creators](https://loreandlootclub.com/creators): reviewers and channels the club recommends, featured with permission
- [Community](https://loreandlootclub.com/community): Royal Road and the subreddits the club recommends for LitRPG, fantasy and sci-fi readers
- [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/loreandlootclub/): reviews, polls and group read check-ins
- [FNS](https://fnsing.io/): the company behind the site. FNS builds agent teams that prepare work for staff judgment.
